SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'borderless' AND colorIndicator = 'B,R,U' AND colors = 'B' AND edhrecRank > 12000;
SELECT p.Title FROM posts p JOIN comments c ON p.Id = c.PostId WHERE c.Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM comments);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;
SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';
SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts ORDER BY Views ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM products p JOIN transactions_1k t ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID JOIN yearmonth ym ON t.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE ym.Date LIKE '201309%';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) FROM account WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND STRFTIME('%Y', badges.Date) = '2011';
SELECT T1.city, T1.state FROM zip_code AS T1 JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip WHERE T2.position = 'President';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'white' AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL;
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN users.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(users.Id) AS Percentage FROM users JOIN posts ON users.Id = posts.OwnerUserId WHERE posts.Score > 5;
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE member.position = 'Vice President';
SELECT T2.MailStreet, T2.School, T1.AvgScrRead FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(client_id) FROM client WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = ( SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 = ( SELECT MAX(A15) FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL AND A15 != 0 ) - 1 );
SELECT st.translation FROM sets s JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode WHERE s.name = 'Eighth Edition' AND st.language = 'Chinese Simplified';
SELECT OwnerDisplayName FROM posts WHERE ViewCount = (SELECT MAX(ViewCount) FROM posts);

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'c' AND SUBSTR(atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT l.uuid, f.language FROM legalities l JOIN sets s ON l.uuid = s.uuid JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode AND st.language = 'Chinese Traditional' JOIN foreign_data f ON st.translation = f.name AND f.language = 'Chinese Traditional' WHERE l.format = 'legacy';
SELECT MIN(T2.CreaionDate) AS FirstPostDate FROM users AS T1 JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId ORDER BY T1.Age ASC, T2.CreaionDate ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, frpm.`District Code` FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.`CDSCode` = schools.`CDSCode` WHERE schools.`AdmFName1` = 'Alusine';
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, d.college FROM member m JOIN major d ON m.link_to_major = d.major_id WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';
SELECT users.Reputation FROM users JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId WHERE badges.Date = '2010-07-19 19:39:08.0';
SELECT p.Title, p.ViewCount FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder') ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.name FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic' AND l.format = 'gladiator' AND l.status = 'Banned';
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.department = 'Art and Design';
SELECT molecule.label FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'ca' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Description FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Admission = '-' AND l.Date LIKE '1991-10%' AND l.T_BIL < 2.0;
SELECT u.DisplayName, u.Location FROM users u JOIN tags t ON u.Id = t.ExcerptPostId WHERE t.TagName = 'hypothesis-testing';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM major WHERE department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education' AND college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences';

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.eye_colour_id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.eye_colour_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS difference FROM superhero AS T1 LEFT JOIN colour AS T2 ON T2.id = T1.eye_colour_id WHERE T1.weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg IS NULL;
SELECT MIN(time) AS fastest_lap_time FROM lapTimes;

SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' ORDER BY l.amount DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT dname, AVG(AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadScore FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY dname ORDER BY AvgReadScore DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT originalType FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';
SELECT p.ClosedDate IS NULL AS isWellFinished FROM postHistory ph JOIN posts p ON ph.PostId = p.Id WHERE ph.UserId = '23853' AND ph.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0' AND ph.Comment IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(T2.UA) AS Average_UA FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA < 8.0) OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA < 6.5) AND T2.Date = (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = T1.ID);
SELECT c.name FROM cards c JOIN set_translations st ON c.setCode = st.setCode JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE st.translation = 'Coldsnap' ORDER BY c.convertedManaCost DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Super Strength';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Examination.`aCL IgG` > 900 AND Examination.`aCL IgG` < 2000 AND Patient.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Commentator' AND STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2014';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl';
SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM schools s JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds WHERE s.State = 'CA' AND s.StatusType = 'Active' ORDER BY sa.NumGE1500 / sa.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', T1.event_date) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', T1.event_date) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END)) AS difference FROM event AS T1 JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE raceId BETWEEN 50 AND 100 AND positionText = 'D' AND time IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(fastestLapTime / 1000) AS average_fastest_lap_time_seconds FROM results JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId WHERE drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND drivers.forename = 'Lewis';
SELECT COUNT(client_id) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';
SELECT AVG(`A15`) FROM district WHERE `A15` > 4000 AND district_id IN ( SELECT district_id FROM account WHERE date LIKE '1997%' );
SELECT `NCESSchool` FROM schools ORDER BY `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT sp.power_name FROM superpower sp JOIN hero_power hp ON sp.id = hp.power_id JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Ajax';
SELECT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.circuitid = T2.circuitid WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';
